Feature.Description:
A SiLA Server for controlling the PlateLoc made by Agilent Technologies.
The PlateLoc is a fully automated laboratory heat sealer. The PlateLoc can apply various seals to various types of microplates. Model number: G5585B Product URL : https://www.chem-agilent.com/contents.php?id=1006101
VWorks ActiveX Control (version 13.1.0.1366 or later) is required on the computer running this SiLA Server.

Command.Description:
Start a seal cycle. This command triggers the execution of steps moving stage in, applying seal, and moving stage out in sequence. If you call this command while another observable command is running, the request will be rejected.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command StartCycle.
Status required to execute this command: Idle Status while this command is running: Running Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Idle If an error occurs: Error

Terminate the seal cycle currently in progress. The following notes apply to this command: * This command may not work as intended because it is executed only after the StartCycle command has completed. * When the StopCycle process is executed, the seal cycle stops immediately, which may cause the seal roll to become slack. This condition can result in an error, so verify the seal roll status and take any required actions. - The StopCycle process can be executed via the GUI without waiting for the StartCycle command to complete.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command StopCycle.
Status required to execute this command: Running Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Idle If an error occurs: Error

Assign the specified parameter value as the seal-cycle duration (in seconds).
Calling this command invokes the instrument command SetSealingTime.
Status required to execute this command: Idle, Running Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Same as the status at the start of execution If an error occurs: Error

Parameter.Description: The value to be set as sealing time.

Command.Description:
Assign the specified parameter value as the sealing temperature (°C) of the hot plate.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command SetSealingTemperature.
Status required to execute this command: Idle, Running Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Same as the status at the start of execution If an error occurs: Error

Parameter.Description: The value to be set as sealing temperature.

Command.Description:
Reset the server to its Idle state. This command is common to all instruments. If you call this command while another observable command is running, the request will be rejected.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command Abort.
Status required to execute this command: Error, Running Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Idle If an error occurs: Error

Enumerate profiles for PlateLoc.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command EnumerateProfiles.
Status required to execute this command: Idle, Running Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes: Same as the status at the start of execution

Property.Description:
Get the sealing temperature (°C) currently set by the user.
Reading this property invokes the instrument command GetSealingTemperature.
Status required to get this property: Idle, Running

Get the sealing time currently set by the user.
Reading this property invokes the instrument command GetSealingTime.
Status required to get this property: Idle, Running

Actual temperature (°C) of the hot plate.
Reading this property invokes the instrument command GetActualTemperature.
Status required to get this property: Idle, Running

The count of seal cycles performed.
Reading this property invokes the instrument command GetCycleCount.
Status required to get this property: Idle, Running

The firmware version of the instrument.
Reading this property invokes the instrument command GetFirmwareVersion.
Status required to get this property: Idle, Running

The version number of the PlateLoc ActiveX Control.
Reading this property invokes the instrument command GetVersion.
Status required to get this property: Idle, Running
Returns the status of the instrument. This property is common to all instruments. 0: Not Connected 1: Idle 2: Running 3: Error
